bullets.text: Fixed `Invoke-GhRetry` to correctly treat exit code 0 as a success and reduced retry delays for improved performance.
Added support for managing repository lists via `config/repos.txt` and supplemental overrides via `extra-repos.txt`.
Enhanced narrow display with non-proportional column shrinking, column chooser functionality, and fixed drag-resize behavior.
Added auto-refresh capability for the maintainers list.
Removed dotnet/dotnet from scanned repositories and improved Invoke-GhRetry error handling.
Made GraphQL scanning more resilient to 502 errors.
Removed local regeneration logic and outdated reports sections.
Added auto-refresh functionality for the maintainers list to ensure it stays up-to-date.
Added auto-refresh functionality for the maintainers list to ensure up-to-date data.
Improved resilience of the indexing pipeline to handle errors more robustly.
Increased incremental cache TTL from 12 hours to 36 hours for better performance and reduced cache misses.
Skipped querying `files()` in GraphQL for large repositories to prevent 502 errors.
Added auto-refresh functionality to the maintainers list.
Fixed Playwright test failures related to dynamic titles, selectors, and scrolling issues.
Updated tier detection to use `github.event.schedule` instead of wall-clock time for more accurate scheduling.
Moved inline styles for the index page's CTA and table to CSS classes for better styling consistency and maintainability.
Improved the test assertion for the CTA (Call-To-Action) to ensure tighter validation.
Added auto-refresh functionality to update the maintainers list dynamically.
Unified report pages into a single all/actionable.html with URL-parameter filtering for easier navigation.
Improved triage behavior by stopping force-refresh for PRs with non-success CI or unknown mergeable status.
Implemented adaptive sub-chunking to handle failed API queries more efficiently.
Added "Next Action" tooltip explaining why each person appears in the list.
Introduced chunked date-range retry logic for large repos, improving handling of 502 errors.
Implemented activity-based fallback reviewer selection, limited to the top 2 reviewers.
Added incremental PR scanning to optimize API quota usage.
Introduced "Next action on maintainer" and "Easy next action on maintainer" filters for the no-user view.
Enabled a lightweight probe to skip unchanged repos, paired with an API quota footer display.
Added a repo filter magnifying glass and removed the external navigation icon.
Reduced chunk size for scanning to 7 days and fixed duplicate log entries for retries.
Fixed StrictMode crash by using safe property access for PSObject.Properties.
Fixed scan JSON corruption from Write-Output interfering with stdout during scans.
Fixed scan failures caused by PowerShell warnings and stream leakage into CI stdout.
Improved missing cache version display in incremental scan warnings.
Addressed scan failures and validation failure cases by adding diagnostic logging and a second-pass retry mechanism for GraphQL queries.
Enhanced fallback behavior in scans when no user filter is applied.
Prevented inferred users in "involves" lists.
Refined "who" logic for multiple retries with added backoff and error logging.
Added 11 standard-tier .NET repositories for daily scans.
Updated README and copilot-instructions.md with coding standards, a pre-push quality checklist, and clarified guidance.
Fixed minor bugs including `waitForFunction` parameter order, whitespace handling in ONLY_GROUPS, and comments in run-parallel.js.
Scheduled a weekly auto-refresh workflow for the maintainers list.
Implemented auto-refresh functionality for the maintainers list.
Added multi-select functionality with recent name tiles to the actionable report for improved usability.
Added interactive area and repository filters with multi-select capability, URL serialization, and corresponding Playwright tests.
Introduced 40 extended Playwright tests to improve coverage for user filter, sorting, popups, and per-repository pages.
Updated merge readiness rules to treat any maintainer approval as sufficient for merging.
Adjusted maintainer resolution to prioritize CODEOWNERS over area labels in determining approvals.
Introduced an 'Easy next actions' filter on all report pages to help streamline follow-up tasks.
Added a "Next action on me only" filter and improved the display for newly-discovered PRs.
Fixed triage accuracy by addressing author exclusion, expanding team coverage, and implementing UI corrections.
Updated Aspire repository reference from `dotnet/aspire` to `microsoft/aspire`.
Fixed cross-repo scheduled text display and restored the pipeline badge.
Rescheduled cron jobs to run at :11 past the hour to reduce GitHub Actions delays.
Updated Aspire merged PR data with 79 merges from the past 7 days.
Adjusted skip-if-recent window from 10 hours to 4 hours for faster updates.
Changed displayed timestamps from UTC to Pacific Time (PST/PDT) for improved readability.
Introduced tiered refresh rates, updating priority repositories about four times daily and others approximately once daily.
Added a full footer to all report pages for consistent navigation and information display.
Added a "Refresh View" feature to improve data updating on the cross-repo dashboard.
Updated roles to no longer treat community triagers as maintainers, aligning with correct permission levels.
Added "involves" filter to improve PR triaging by narrowing results based on specific users.
Introduced "your-turn" highlighting to quickly identify PRs requiring user attention.
Corrected maintainer text for clarity and consistency in the UI.
Added a "need bonus" functionality to prevent CI from blocking merges on approved pull requests.
Updated the PR Dashboard link and introduced a new section for the Issue Dashboard.
Optimized per-row refresh with a single API call, added stale score fading effect, and implemented a rate limit footer.
Fixed incorrect rendering of bot reviewers in the cross-repo report.
Added a bot icon to replace the avatar and name for Copilot reviewer displays.
Implemented a community badge display for user mentions in the Next Action column.
Added a "Repo Health" link to the dashboard footer.
Enhanced cross-repo page with shared CSS/JS for improved consistency and performance.
Fixed issues with CI scoring when absent and updated tooltips and annotations in the scoring table.
Improved PR scoring logic by boosting scores for trivial PRs like typo fixes and comment-only changes.
Fixed column resizing issue by locking the table layout during drag operations.
Adjusted attention score logic so that silent authors reduce the attention score instead of increasing it.
Optimized report schedule: reduced runs on weekends and skipped redundant executions.
Renamed the "Files" column to "Size," added lines changed info, and introduced a mouse icon for clarity.
Added a workflow status badge to both the README and report footers.
Documented the security properties of the client-side refresh button.
Introduced a triple-score system (Ready/Need/Action) with an enhanced UI for improved triage clarity.
Added author response latency as a recommended next step to aid decision-making.
Implemented empirical weight calibration analysis based on 980 PRs across 11 repositories for data-driven prioritization.
Added daily changelog with AI-generated commit summaries to enhance project tracking.
Enabled auto-discovery of maintainers through merge history and prioritized engaged maintainers in selection processes.
Added CI validation workflow, including testing scripts, to ensure proper PR handling.
Add per-PR refresh button to all report pages
Document TimestampIso parameter in ConvertTo-ReportHtml.ps1
Fix emoji ordering for compound actions
Harden MutationObserver, polish styling, hide merged/closed PRs
Ignore self-approvals: author signing off on own PR is not meaningful
Improve next_action for conflicts/CI: check feedback before review-needed
Show review-needed instead of fix-CI when no approvals; fetch requested reviewers
Use review comment dates for staleness/freshness; reward recent engagement
Add cross-repo actionable PRs view
Add test screenshots to gitignore
Make pipeline resilient to individual repo failures
Update dashboard link formatting in README
Add area-label badges to PR dashboard reports
Add dotnet/maui to PR dashboard
Add feedback badge to reports and index
Conditionally hide Area column for repos without area labels
Fetch full titles for all repos and regenerate reports
Improve column layout: full titles, wider Next Action, remove Who column
Read schedule hours from workflow YAML in Regen-Html
Regenerate all reports with new column layout
Regenerate skills reports with new column layout
Remove Who column; fold maintainer names into Next Action
Scope filter JS to main PR table only
